cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay for tea. I need to tell the children about tomorrow's operation. You remember how often I made you rehearse before facing an audience.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then be my audience. Don't prompt if I stop; you always wanted the next word too quickly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask for two minutes. Let me get through 'I'll be in hospital' once without a prompt. Then I'll fetch them.
